title: Development of UPLC-MS/MS method and its pharmacokinetic application for estimation of sertraline in rat plasma
author: Rahman

steps.title: Prepare sertraline stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 10 mg of sertraline in 100 mL methanol to obtain a stock solution of 0.1 mg/mL.

steps.title: Prepare sertraline working solution
steps.instruction: Dilute 1 mL of the 0.1 mg/mL stock solution with methanol to a final volume of 100 mL, yielding a working solution of 1 µg/mL.

steps.title: Prepare calibration standards in plasma
steps.instruction: Spike rat plasma with appropriate volumes of the 1 µg/mL working solution to obtain calibration concentrations of 0.1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 80, and 100 ng/mL.

steps.title: Filter calibration samples
steps.instruction: Pass each calibration sample through a 0.22 µm membrane filter before injection into the chromatographic system.

steps.title: Prepare internal‑standard solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the sertraline stock solution with methanol to obtain an internal‑standard (IS) working solution of 100 ng/mL.

steps.title: Prepare quality‑control samples
steps.instruction: Spike blank rat plasma with the sertraline working solution to produce QC samples at 5 ng/mL (low), 25 ng/mL (medium), and 100 ng/mL (high).

steps.title: Extract sertraline from plasma
steps.instruction: Perform liquid‑liquid extraction of each 100 µL plasma sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 0.1 M sodium hydroxide solution and 1 mL ethyl acetate to a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube containing the plasma.
Vigorously shake the tube to ensure complete mixing.
Transfer the clear supernatant to a clean tube.

steps.title: Evaporate extract to dryness
steps.instruction: Dry the collected supernatant in a vacuum concentrator set to 40 °C until all solvent is removed.

steps.title: Reconstitute dried residue
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of the mobile phase to the dried residue and vortex to dissolve.

steps.title: Centrifuge reconstituted sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the reconstituted mixture at 15,000 rpm for 5 min.

steps.title: Store final extract for analysis
steps.instruction: Transfer the clear supernatant to a storage vial and keep at –20 °C until UPLC‑MS/MS analysis.

description: The guideline of United States Food and Drug administration (USFDA) was followed for the validation of the analytical method and the parameters taken into account were linearity, precision, accuracy, extraction recovery, matrix effect, robustness, and solution stability at different temperature conditions and time periods [13].
